statement_summary: Written information security program with the 314.4 elements
Qualified Individual designated in writing with authority and budget
Written risk assessment each August using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority by risk level
Written exceptions; MFA and encryption exceptions need Qualified Individual approval
Sanctions for employees and contractor sales associates
Service provider assessment, contract terms, and annual review
Annual control assessment; annual penetration test and semiannual vulnerability assessments
Written annual report to the majority owner
Unique named accounts; no shared accounts
Role-based least privilege; agents see own and team transactions
MFA for every user including contractors; phishing-resistant for admins and money movers; legacy protocols off
Same-day access removal for employees and departing contractor agents; weekly license roster check
Quarterly access reviews including online banking users
Dual approval for every escrow account wire
Personal devices only through managed apps; guest Wi-Fi in offices
Paper customer files locked with a key log
Written incident response plan with runbooks
Report suspected incidents immediately, within 1 hour, including contractors
Funds response first: bank recall and IC3 complaint
Meet FTC, Florida, and other notification deadlines
Annual tabletop exercise and role training
Lessons learned within 30 days; update risk register and POA&M
Independent callback for every payoff, proceeds wire, and changed instruction; monthly sample
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit, or approved compensating control
Wire instructions and closing documents only through the portal
Inventory of where customer information is stored
Retention schedule with two-year disposal rule
Annual retention review and purge
Certified destruction of paper and media
Isolated immutable backups tested quarterly; independent SaaS backup
Annual training for employees and contractors; BEC content; quarterly phishing exercises
Never send or forward wire instructions
No forwarding of company email to outside accounts
Approved generative AI tools only
